div.span: Focal Control Room UI (Full State & Exposure)
AI Decision Support Boundary (Disabled by default in Phase 1)

Relational Projections (Drizzle ORM)
- suppliers, warehouses, inventory_lots
- shipments, customer_orders, order_lines
- integration_connections & integration_inbox
- document_records, document_files, document_chunks
Route Body Limits (25MB docs / 8MB general / 2MB imports)
Role & Org RBAC Check (6 Switchable Personas)
Freight Document Intake (POST /api/documents up to 25 MB)
